description: This Java class implements a strategy for handling the RetrieveAcl command in the Eclipse Ditto framework. It retrieves the Access Control List (ACL) from a Thing object, constructs a response with optional ETag headers, and manages entity tags for optimistic locking.

classes.name: RetrieveAclStrategy
classes.description: A strategy class that handles the RetrieveAcl command by extracting the ACL from a Thing, creating a response, and managing entity tags.

methods.name: doApply
methods.description: Executes the command logic: extracts the ACL, creates a response with optional ETag headers, and returns the result.

methods.name: extractAcl
methods.description: Retrieves the AccessControlList from the provided Thing object.

methods.name: previousEntityTag
methods.description: Provides optional entity tag for the previous state for concurrency control.

methods.name: nextEntityTag
methods.description: Provides optional entity tag based on the current state of the Thing.
